adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx`, `handleAdd` does `if (multiEmailValue.length === 0) { return; }` with no toast/error/state change. The new `MultiEmail` component allows removing the last email row (`updatedValue.splice(index, 1)`), which can set the value to `[]`. In that state, clicking the "Add" button triggers `handleAdd` and silently does nothing, matching the reported dead-button behavior.
